ISUZU in Thailand

Isuzu started production and sale of the vehicles in Thailand from 1957, ahead of other competitors as the trusts in potential of Thai country and people.

Ever since, Isuzu vehicles and diesel engines excellent in durability and reliability and better in design have grabbed the users' needs adequately and gained the overwhelming support of the Thai consumers for years.

As Isuzu Motors found and trust in Thailand's potential and Thai people's capability, in 2002 ISUZU moved production base of 1 Ton vehicle( pick-up truck) to Thailand.

And also, Isuzu moved R&D base of pick-up truck to Thailand as well in 2010.
